title: Norway – Accounting services – Accounting and payroll services for Follo Ren IKS
description: Background Follo Ren IKS needs to enter into a new agreement for accounting and payroll services as the current agreement expires. The procurement shall ensure safe, stable and professional delivery, which supports correct and timely reporting. Follo Ren IKS is an intermunicipal company that lays down annual accounts in accordance with the Accounting Act, good accounting practice and applicable regulations for intermunicipal companies, including KOSTRA reporting. The entity is mainly covered by the self-cost regulations and is not taxable, whilst the business part is taxable and shall be reported separately. This sets requirements for solid competence in accounting, wages, public reporting and the divide between the self-cost area and business activities. Follo Ren IKS has 44 permanent employees and approx. 40 temporary employees. The turnover in 2025 was NOK 178.77 million in the self-cost area and NOK 11.48 million in the business activities. Tenderers ought, therefore, to have an understanding of the business ́s size, organisation and reporting complexity. The assignment shall be carried out by using Follo Ren IKS ́ system, Visma BNXT. Further information on the entity is available at the www.folloren.no. The annual report for 2025 is available on the www.folloren.no/om-follo-ren/publikasjoner. Description of the assignment Follo Ren IKS shall procure accounting and payroll services that cover the ongoing financial and payroll management in the entity. The delivery shall be carried out in Follo Ren IKS ́ system, Visma BNXT, and includes assistance in wages, accounts, reconciliation, accruals, documentation, annual settlements, refunds and reports to authorities. The assignment includes, among other things, wages execution, checking wage transactions, handling deviations and repayments, accounting reconciliations and quality assured reporting. Tenderers shall also contribute to a correct annual report, KOSTRA reporting and tax reports, including ensuring the necessary control of the distinction between the self-cost area and the taxable business part. A delivery is requested with high professional quality, clear control routines and predictable interaction. Follo Ren IKS needs a permanent gender neutral preferred, close and ongoing dialogue as well as a quick response as needed in relation to wages, accounts and reports. Tenderers must have available competence that fulfils the requirements for quality, compliance and continuity of the delivery.

description: Background and purpose About the Contracting Authority The contracting authority for this procurement is Møre og Romsdal County, c/o the Transport sector, department FRAM (hereafter called the Contracting Authority). Møre og Romsdal county is marketing the boat, bus and ferry offer in the county under the brand FRAM. The contracting authority is part of a public-public cooperation, called OMS (Public Mobility Cooperation). The partners in OMS are currently AtB (Trøndelag ́s mobility company), ReisNordland (Nordland Fylkeskommune), Svipper (Troms Fylkeskommune), Innlandstrafikk (Innlandet fylkeskommune), Farte (Telemark fylkeskommune), VKT (Vestfold kollektiv trafikk) and EnTur. There may be other OOS cooperation that the Contracting Authorities are entering into during the agreement period. This means that partners in these cooperations shall also be able to enter into this agreement. The contracting authority can change who is the OMS partner. contract period. All OMS partners shall be able to use this framework agreement for assignments connected to OMS. All call-offs on the framework agreement shall go via the Contracting Authority, but actual hours can be invoiced to the partner. This will be agreed upon by call-offs. About the Assignment The contracting authority shall enter into a framework agreement with one tenderer. The tenderer shall assist the Contracting Authority with development and further development of new digital systems for the Contracting Authority and OMS partners. The contracting authority has its main office in Molde – the County House in Julsundvegen 9. The contracting authority does not have requirements for a place of work for developers. Developers must reckon on close contact with the Contracting Authority in Molde, and will often cooperate with the existing development team at other members of OMS. If appropriate, some developers can have a work place at FRAM in our premises at The County Hall in Molde. All project documentation and all meetings will be in Norwegian, and communication will mainly occur online, or at physical meetings. Tenderers must reckon on travelling to the Contracting Authority's office location, to other development teams or to other OMS members, in particular during the start-up period. Developers shall deliver timesheets that distribute hours on different sub projects, and it shall be possible to reckon on each of the relevant partners who make call-offs. description: Przedmiotem zamówienia jest odbiór i zagospodarowanie odpadów komunalnych z terenu gminy Zbąszynek. Zakres zamówienia dotyczy posesji zamieszkałych tj. nieruchomości wykorzystywanych do celów mieszkalnych oraz nieruchomości mieszkalno-użytkowych lub użytkowo mieszkalnych w części mieszkalnej oraz nieruchomości, na których znajdują się domki letniskowe lub inne nieruchomości wykorzystywane na cele rekreacyjno – wypoczynkowe Przedmiot zamówienia nie został podzielony na części. Zamawiający nie dopuszcza składania ofert częściowych. Przedmiotem zamówienia jest Odbiór i zagospodarowanie odpadów komunalnych. Dopiero wykonanie całości usług pozwoli na ocenę prawidłowości wykonanych usług. Wydzielenie części zamówienia wobec stałego sukcesywnego zakresu całego zamówienia spowoduje konieczność koordynacji usług kilku wykonawców przez zamawiającego i może stanowić ryzyko nieskoordynowania działań wykonawców. W ocenie Zamawiającego przedmiot zamówienia uzasadnia udzielenie zamówienia jednemu wykonawcy, który przyjmie na siebie odpowiedzialność za ryzyko wykonanie usługi a dokonanie podziału zamówienia na części mogłoby to ryzyko przenieść na Zamawiającego i w konsekwencji uczynić niemożliwym osiągnięcie celu zamówienia publicznego. Realizacja jednej usługi przez kilku wykonawców stanowi również utrudnienie w korzystaniu w uprawnień z tytułu rękojmi i gwarancji jakości. Reasumując w przedmiotowym postępowaniu podział zamówienia na części nie przyniósłby Zamawiającemu, ani wykonawcom korzyści, a także ze względu na zakres i wartość zamówienia nie doprowadziłby do otwarcia postępowania na konkurencję.

description: 1. Възложителят изпраща писмено по електронна поща, поръчка за доставка към Доставчика. Доставчикът доставя стоки, отговарящи на всички изисквания и условия, заложени в настоящия договор и на изискванията на действащото българско законодателство, в рамките на срока за доставка. 4. Срокът за доставка на Стоките от Ценовите таблици е до 5 (пет) работни дни от датата на поръчката от страна на Възложителя. 5. Доставчикът се задължава при извършване на всяка доставка да представя на Възложителя документите, съгласно действащата Наредба № РД-02-20-1 от 5 февруари 2015 г. за условията и реда за влагане на строителни продукти в строежите на Република България, както и инструкции за употреба на български език. Също така, при извършване на всяка доставка Доставчикът е длъжен да представя и всички останали приложими документи, изискуеми в съответствие с действащото в Република България законодателство. Без предоставяне на тези документи, Възложителят има право да откаже приемане на стоките или да забави или да откаже плащане на Доставчика до получаване на посочените по-горе документи. 6. Възложителят приема от Доставчика доставените Стоки, отговарящи на изискванията на Договора, като страните подписват без възражения приемо-предавателен протокол. 7. В случай че при доставката на Стоките се установят несъответствия на доставените стоки с изискванията на договора, Възложителят подписва Констативен протокол, без да приема стоката. 8. Датата, на която Доставчикът замени неприетите по предходния член стоки с такива, отговарящи на изискванията на договора, ще се счита за дата на доставка на поръчаните Стоки. В случай че тази дата е след срока за доставка на поръчаните стоки (считано от датата на поръчката), Доставчикът дължи неустойка за забава по чл.1.2 от Раздел В: Специфични условия. 9. При установени след доставката несъответствия в доставени стоки, Доставчикът се задължава да ги замени с такива, отговарящи на изискванията на договора, в срок до 5 (пет) работни дни от писменото уведомяване от страна на Възложителя. При неспазване на срока за замяна на такива стоки, в зависимост от забавянето, Възложителят прилага клаузите, заложени в Раздел В: Специфични условия.

Zelená infrastruktura Holešov – městské parky (vegetační úpravy) Komplexní zhodnocení veřejného prostranství a návrh celkové regenerace prostoru za účelem obnovy a posílení funkčnosti zelené infrastruktury ve veřejném prostranství a posílení ekosystémových služeb sídelní zeleně, zejména ke zvýšení potenciálu adaptace sídla ke změnám klimatu jako je zadržování vláhy, ochlazování svého okolí, zmírnění teplotních extrémů – zejména zadržením vody v území s přeměnou nepropustných povrchů za propustné. Americký park V lokalitě je nutné provést kácení provozně nebezpečných dřevin a dále dřevin za účelem rozvolnění hustého zápoje a zejména uvolnění hodnotnějších stromů a zejména redukce stanovištně nevhodných invazivních akátů. Pro uvolnění pro novou výsadbu je také nezbytné kácení řady nekoncepčně vysazených keřů a náletů. Podrobně viz dendrologický průzkum uvedený v tabulkové části. - Celkem bude káceno 87 ks stromů a 2 493 ks keřů a náletů, téměř třetinu tvoří invazivní akát. - Náhradní výsadba bude obsahovat 46 ks stromů, které vytvoří kostru porostů v dosud nefungujících částech parku, výrazně bude posíleno keřové patro s výsadbou 6540ks keřů a růží. - Bylinné patro bude zastoupeno 2400 m2 druhově pestrých lučních směsí. V rámci ošetření dřevin budou u mladých výsadeb provedeny výchovné řezy, u starších pak zdravotní a bezpečnostní řezy, redukční řezy z důvodu stabilizace, směrem k překážce a úpravou průjezdního profilu, dále obvodové redukce a u senescentních stromů také přírodě blízká redukce koruny. U několika stromů bude instalována bezpečnostní vazba, dále revize bezpečnostní vazby u dubů. U stromu č. 310 Abies nordmaniana je nutné provést přístrojovou tahovou zkoušku. V rámci výsadby je navržena celková obnova vegetačních prvků v parku za účelem obnovy celé kompozice a vytvoření jednotlivých kompozičních celků. Provedena bude dosadba kosterních dřevin, zejména rozšíření druhové skladby stromů, dojde k významnému posílení keřového patra v podobě domácích i okrasných druhů a zejména založení chybějícího bylinného patra v podobě trvalkových záhonů, záhonů růží a druhově pestrých lučních trávníků. Dojde tak k výraznému zvýšení druhové pestrosti a posílení biologické hodnoty plochy. Vybraný dodavatel je povinen v rámci plnění předmětu zakázky zajistit plnění principů DNSH – pravidla ochrany životního prostředí vyžadovaná při realizaci díla. Veškeré aktivity projektu musí být realizovány v souladu s cíli a zásadami udržitelného rozvoje a zásadou „významně nepoškozovat“ (dále jen „DNSH“) v oblasti životního prostředí.

title: Delivery of Electric Buses for the municipality of Chodziez, Poland
description:
The subject of the procurement is the supply of brand-new electric buses (vehicles with an exclusively electric powertrain – BEV) for the Municipality of Chodzież, intended for the provision of municipal public transport within the Municipality.

The contract is divided into the following scopes:

• base scope – the supply of 1 electric bus in accordance;

• optional scope (Right of Option) – the supply of 1 electric bus

A "brand-new" bus is defined as a vehicle manufactured no earlier than 6 months prior to the delivery date of the given batch, and one that has not been previously used. The buses offered must be of the same brand and identical in terms of construction, technical parameters, configuration, and equipment.

The scope of the contract also includes the performance of activities ancillary to the deliveries, in particular:

• providing the Contracting Authority with internal authorization for the maintenance and repair of the supplied BEV (battery electric vehicle) buses;

• equipping the Contracting Authority with a set of service tools for diagnosing all vehicle components—in a quantity and scope that enables the full utilization of all functionalities of the BEV buses;

• providing, free of charge, the technical documentation required for the maintenance and servicing of the purchased vehicles;

• conducting training for the Contracting Authority’s staff and/or the public transport operator’s personnel (a minimum of 3 mechanics/technical support staff and 4 drivers).

title: 33210.201 & 33210.202 - Rute 11 Udbygning af Varde - Korskro
description: Entrepriseudbuddet omfatter to delkontrakter: LOT-0001: Entreprise 33210.201. Denne delkontrakt vedrører ombygning af TSA-anlæg 73 ved Korskro. Arbejdet omfatter etablering af to stitunneler og en stibro samt ombygning af det eksisterende tilslutningsanlæg, herunder tilpasning af ramper. LOT-0002: Entreprise 33210.202. Denne delkontrakt omfatter udbygning af Rute 11 til en 2+1 vej. Projektet inkluderer afskærende kommuneveje, etablering af nye adgangsveje samt anlæg af en kombination cykelsti og 2-1 vej på den nordøstlige side af Rute 11. Det bemærkes, at det minimumskrav til egnethed, der vedrøre nettoomsætning for seneste regnskabsår akkumuleres ved tilbudsafgivelse på begge delkontrakter. Nettoomsætningen for seneste regnskabsår skal være mindst 150 mio. DKK for at samme tilbudsgiver kan tildeles begge delkontrakter. Konstateres det, at en tilbudsgiver har afgivet tilbud på begge delkontrakter, men kun kan opfylde minimumskravet vedrørende nettoomsætning for én delkontrakt vil der når det økonomisk mest fordelagtige tilbud på grundlag tildelingskriteriet pris skal identificeres ses på den økonomisk mest fordelagtige kombination af vindende tilbudsgivere på tværs af de to udbudte delkontrakter.

description: Het doel van de opdracht is om één (1) professionele beveiligingsdienstverlener te contracteren die gedurende minimaal drie (3) en maximaal zes (6) jaar zorgt voor de betrouwbare, continue en protocol-gestuurde uitvoering van alle benodigde beveiligingsdiensten binnen HHR waarvan tenminste meldkamer, alarmopvolging, cameraverificatie, lopen van brand- en sluitrondes en incidentele uitvragen voor beveiligers/suppoosten. Het beoogde eindresultaat is een goed functionerende, beheersbare en flexibele Raamovereenkomst waarin: *Alle beveiligingsdiensten betrouwbaar en conform vaste protocollen worden uitgevoerd, waaronder meldkamerwerkzaamheden, alarmopvolging, cameraverificatie, brand- en sluitrondes, surveillances, openen/sluiten en suppoostdiensten. *Een stabiel en veilig app- en online platform beschikbaar is waarmee geautoriseerde medewerkers (ca. 150) zelfstandig operationele instellingen kunnen beheren zoals teststanden, roostertijden en locatie gebonden activiteitenlogs. *De dienstverlening voldoet aan alle wettelijke verplichtingen, kwaliteitsnormen, KPI’s, responstijdnormen en privacy- en beveiligingseisen (AVG, ISO’s, Wpbr/Rpbr, Wwke en NIS2). *Mogelijkheid om aanvullende diensten zoals alleen werkenopvolging, centralistdienst, vaste beveiligingsdienst en innovatiepilots binnen dezelfde Raamovereenkomst toe te voegen. *De Opdrachtgever wordt ontzorgd, terwijl de functionarissen van de afdeling fysieke beveiliging en de contractmanager kunnen sturen op kwaliteit, naleving en continuïteit. *Ruimte bestaat voor doorontwikkeling en innovatie, zodat de beveiligingsdienstverlening meebeweegt met technologische en organisatorische ontwikkelingen. Het eindresultaat is daarmee een veilige, toekomstbestendige en integraal georganiseerde beveiligingsketen die de bedrijfsvoering van HHR ondersteunt en beschermt.

title: Refuse Collection Vehicle Fleet Expansion
description:
This tender aims to procure nine electric-drive refuse collection vehicles with low-floor cabs, along with the corresponding superstructures and a crane for emptying underground containers. The vehicles will be used for refuse collection, paper and cardboard collection, as well as the collection of organic and green waste. Furthermore, they must be suitable for bag collection and the emptying of both containers and underground containers.

The contracting authority notes that the financing for the overall project is not yet definitively secured at the time of this tender. The award of the contract is subject to the explicit condition that the funds are provided completely and in a timely manner, or that the credit is approved (decision by the assembly of delegates).

Should the financing fail to materialize, the contracting authority reserves the right to cancel the procurement procedure in whole or in part. In this case, any claims for damages by bidders, particularly regarding the costs incurred for preparing the bid, are excluded.

title: Metsänhoidon palvelusopimus 2027-2028 (2029-2030)
description: Metsänhoidon palvelusopimus 2027-2028 (2029-2030) Mäntsälän kunta pyytää tarjoustanne metsänhoidon palvelusopimuksesta, jonka tavoitteena on turvata talous- ja puistometsien laadukas metsänhoito, hakkuumahdollisuuksien täysimääräinen ja suunnitelmallinen hyödyntäminen talousmetsissä, maisemanhoito ja virkistysmahdollisuuksien huomioiminen sekä tilaajan edunvalvonta metsänhoitoon liittyvissä asioissa. Metsäpalvelusopimus laaditaan vuosille 2027-2028 ja sopimusta voidaan jatkaa yhdellä kahden (2) vuoden mittaisella optiokaudella. Mäntsälän kunta omistaa noin 870 hehtaaria metsää, jota hoidetaan vuosille 2024–2033 laaditun metsäsuunnitelman mukaisesti. Metsäsuunnitelma on tarjouspyynnön liitteenä. Suunnitelman keskeinen periaate on, että hakkuut ja metsänhoitotyöt kilpailutetaan erikseen, jotta kunta saa puukaupasta parhaan tuoton ja töistä kustannustehokkaan toteutuksen. Palveluntuottaja suunnittelee, kilpailuttaa ja valvoo metsänhoitotyöt kunnan lukuun. Työt tilataan kunnan vuosisuunnitelman mukaisesti. Alihankinta on sallittu, eikä tarjoajalta edellytetä omaa konekalustoa. Tarjouspyynnöllä annetut arviot perustuvat metsäsuunnitelmaan ja siinä määriteltyyn hakkuiden toteumaan. Arvioissa on huomioitu vuosille 2027-2033 suunnitellut hakkuut: - hakkuukertymä 2000-2500 m3/vuosi - puukaupan tulot 90 000-100 000 euroa/vuosi - hakkuut n. 20 ha/vuosi - metsänhoitotyöt, kuten taimikonhoito, raivaus, istutus tai muut vastaavat työt n. 15-25 ha/vuosi. Vuosittaiset määrät vaihtelevat sen mukaan mitä hakkuita ja töitä kulloinkin toteutetaan. Tilaaja ei sitoudu tiettyihin hankintamääriin, vaan hankinnat tehdään tilaajan tarpeen ja määrärahojen puitteissa. Metsäsuunnitelman ulkopuoliset pienehköt hankintahakkuut (infra-alue, myrskytuho tai muut vastaavat) palveluntuottaja suorittaa puun myynnin parhaaseen mahdolliseen markkinahintaan. Markkinakartoitus ja hankinnan osiin jakaminen: Hankinnan valmisteluvaiheessa on toteutettu markkinakartoitus, joka kuvataan hankinta-asiakirjoissa hankintaa koskevissa lisätiedoissa. Hankintayksikkö kilpailuttaa metsänhoidon palvelusopimuksen yhtenä kokonaisuutena ja valitsee sopimuskaudelle yhden (1) palveluntuottajan. Osiin jakamatta jättämisen perusteena on hankintayksikön oma sekä markkinakartoituksen infotilaisuudessa saatu alan toimijoiden näkemys, että hankinta muodostaa toiminnallisesti luontevan kokonaisuuden, jonka jakaminen osiin ei ole tarkoituksenmukaista. Hankinnan osiin jakaminen lisäisi hallinnollista taakkaa ja koordinointia, nostaisi siten kokonaiskustannuksia logististen ja operatiivisten päällekkäisyyksien vuoksi, sekä hajottaisi vastuita, mikä voisi heikentää metsänhoidon laadun ja aikataulujen hallintaa. Yhtenäinen hankintakokonaisuus edistää kustannustehokkuutta, vastaa markkinan rakennetta eikä rajoita kilpailua.,

Da behovet for prærør og muffemontage vil variere i såvel tid som mængde, udbydes aftalen som en rammeaftale, der danner grundlag for, at enkeltstående opgaver kan rekvireres af Ordregiver i Rammeaftalens løbetid. Udbuddet omfatter levering af præisolerede rør (prærør) og tilhørende komponenter til Aalborg Forsynings fjernvarme- og fjernkølenet samt montage af svejste muffesamlinger. Leverancerne og montagearbejdet skal kunne anvendes ved udbygning af nettene og ved reparation, løbende vedligeholdelse og planlagt renovering af eksisterende anlæg. Rammeaftalen skal dermed dække både planlagte opgaver og behov, der opstår i forbindelse med reparation og vedligeholdelse i rammeaftaleperioden. For en yderligere beskrivelse af rammeaftalens indhold og krav henvises der til Rammeaftalen med tilhørende bilag, herunder særligt Bilag 1 – Kravspecifikation og Bilag 2 – Betingelser for muffemontage (svejste muffer) Aalborg. Udbuddet gennemføres som et offentligt udbud i henhold til forsyningsvirksomhedsdirektivets art. 45. Rammeaftalen indgås med Aalborg Service A/S som Rammeaftaleholder. Kontraktstyring og administration af Rammeaftalen varetages af Ordregiver. Ordregiver ønsker én Leverandør på Rammeaftalen. Leverandøren vil være eneleverandør af de udbudte leverancer i forhold til Ordregivers aktuelle behov. Der gøres særligt opmærksom på, at Rammeaftalen ikke er eksklusiv. Med henvisning til forsyningsvirksomhedsdirektivets artikel 65 har Ordregiver valgt ikke at opdele udbuddet i særskilte delaftaler, idet behovet for korte leveringstider for rør og komponenter samt montage af svejste muffesamlinger med kort varsel bedst imødekommes ved en samlet rammeaftale.

title: Rammeavtale for utvikling og videreutvikling av digitale løsninger for FRAM
description: Bakgrunn og formål Om Oppdragsgiver Oppdragsgiver for denne anskaffelsen er Møre og Romsdal Fylkeskommune ved Samferdselssektoren, avdeling FRAM (heretter kalt Oppdragsgiver). Møre og Romsdal fylkeskommune markedsfører båt-, buss- og ferjetilbudet i fylket under merkevaren FRAM. Oppdragsgiver er med i et offentlig-offentlig samarbeid, kalt OMS (Offentlig mobilitetssamarbeid). Partnerne i OMS er pt. AtB (Trøndelags mobilitetsselskap), ReisNordland (Nordland Fylkeskommune), Svipper (Troms Fylkeskommune), Innlandstrafikk (Innlandet fylkeskommune), Farte (Telemark fylkeskommune), VKT (Vestfold kollektiv trafikk) og EnTur. Det kan være andre OOS-samarbeid Oppdragsgivere går inn i, i avtaleperioden. Dette medfører at partnere i disse samarbeidene, også skal kunne knyttes denne avtalen. Hvem som er OMS-partner, kan endres av Oppdragsgiver ila. kontraktsperioden. Alle OMS-partnere skal kunne benytte seg av denne rammeavtalen på oppdrag knyttet til OMS. Alle avrop på rammeavtalen skal gå via Oppdragsgiver, men faktiske timer kan faktureres mot partneren. Dette avtales ved avrop. Om Oppdraget Oppdragsgiver skal inngå en rammeavtale med èn leverandør. Leverandør skal bistå Oppdragsgiver med å utvikle og videreutvikle nye digitale løsninger for Oppdragsgiver og OMS-partnerne. Oppdragsgiver har hovedkontor i Molde – Fylkeshuset i Julsundvegen 9. Oppdragsgiver stiller ikke krav til arbeidssted for utviklere. Utviklere må påregne tett kontakt med Oppdragsgiver i Molde, og vil ofte samarbeide med eksisterende utviklingsteam hos andre medlemmer av OMS. Dersom det er hensiktsmessig, kan noen utviklere ha arbeidssted hos FRAM i våre lokaler på Fylkeshuset i Molde. All prosjektdokumentasjon og alle møter vil være på norsk, og kommunikasjon vil hovedsakelig skje online, eller ved fysisk oppmøte. Leverandør må påregne reiser til Oppdragsgivers kontorsted, til andre utviklingsteam eller til andre OMS-medlemmer, spesielt i oppstartsperioden. Utviklere skal levere timelister som fordeler timeverk på ulike delprosjekter, og det skal være mulig å avregne til hver av de aktuelle partnerne som gjør avrop. For mer informasjon om Oppdraget, se Bilag 3.1 Oppdragsbeskrivelse og Bilag 3.2 Kravspesifikasjon.

title: Regnskaps- og lønnstjenester for Follo Ren IKS
description: Bakgrunn Follo Ren IKS har behov for å inngå ny avtale om regnskaps- og lønnstjenester fordi dagens avtale utløper. Anskaffelsen skal sikre en trygg, stabil og faglig leveranse, som understøtter korrekt og rettidig rapportering. Follo Ren IKS er et interkommunalt selskap som avlegger årsregnskap i samsvar med regnskapsloven, god regnskapsskikk og gjeldende regelverk for interkommunale selskaper, herunder KOSTRA-rapportering. Virksomheten er i hovedsak omfattet av selvkostregelverket og er ikke skattepliktig, mens næringsdelen er skattepliktig og skal rapporteres særskilt. Dette stiller krav til solid kompetanse innen regnskap, lønn, offentlig rapportering og skillet mellom selvkostområdet og næringsvirksomhet. Follo Ren IKS har 44 faste ansatte samt om lag 40 tilkallingsvikarer og midlertidig ansatte. Omsetningen i 2025 var 178,77 millioner kroner innen selvkostområdet og 11,48 millioner kroner innen næringsvirksomheten. Leverandørene bør derfor ha forståelse for virksomhetens størrelse, organisering og rapporteringsmessige kompleksitet. Oppdraget skal utføres ved bruk av Follo Ren IKS sitt system, Visma BNXT. Nærmere informasjon om virksomheten finnes på www.folloren.no. Årsrapport for 2025 er tilgjengelig på www.folloren.no/om-follo-ren/publikasjoner. Beskrivelse av oppdraget Follo Ren IKS skal anskaffe regnskaps- og lønnstjenester som dekker den løpende økonomi- og lønnsforvaltningen i virksomheten. Leveransen skal utføres i Follo Ren IKS sitt system, Visma BNXT, og omfatter bistand innen lønn, regnskap, avstemming, periodisering, dokumentasjon, årsoppgjør, refusjoner samt rapportering til myndigheter. Oppdraget omfatter blant annet lønnskjøring, kontroll av lønnstransaksjoner, håndtering av avvik og etterbetalinger, regnskapsmessige avstemminger og kvalitetssikret rapportering. Leverandøren skal også bidra til korrekt årsoppgjør, KOSTRA-rapportering og skatterapportering, herunder sikre nødvendig kontroll med skillet mellom selvkostområdet og den skattepliktige næringsdelen. Det etterspørres en leveranse med høy faglig kvalitet, tydelige kontrollrutiner og forutsigbar samhandling. Follo Ren IKS har behov for fast kontaktperson, tett og løpende dialog samt rask respons ved behov knyttet til lønn, regnskap og rapportering. Leverandøren må ha tilgjengelig kompetanse som ivaretar kravene til kvalitet, etterlevelse og kontinuitet i leveransen.

title: Ireland – World wide web (www) site design services – Tionscadal Forbartha Teicneolaíochta: Open competition for the design, implementation, support of an integrated examination management ecosystem for TEG – Phase 1 535
description: TEG (Teastas Eorpach na Gaeilge, or “European Certificate in Irish”) is a professional language testing service provided by Maynooth University’s Lárionad na Gaeilge (The Centre for Irish Language). We offer standardised Irish language proficiency exams and certification for learners and skilled users of Irish alike who wish to obtain an independent qualification in Irish that is recognised nationally and internationally. TEG is the only independent certification system available for Irish and the only system that is broadly aligned with the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR), the most widely used international framework for measuring language ability. TEG exams cover levels A1 to C1 of the CEFR, examining four language skills: speaking, listening, reading and writing. Lárionad na Gaeilge is a member of the Association of Language Testers in Europe (ALTE), an association whose members include major European professional language testing organisations. ALTE monitors and regularly audits TEG examinations to ensure that they meet the highest standards and international best practice. TEG has been awarded the ALTE Q-mark three times, in 2015, 2020 and again in 2025 as confirmation that our exams meet all the core requirements of ALTE's 18 quality standards. TEG has now been in existence for over 20 years and over 23,000 candidates have taken the exams during that time.

title: CHL NBC VE 4754 Pathologie mit Kühlzellen
description: Das Klinikum Centre Hospitalier de Luxembourg beabsichtigt im Zuge des Neubaus einige Pathologieeinrichtung gemäß dem Vergabeverfahren „Buch II Offenes Verfahren (Loi, Art. 63 und 65)" zu beschaffen. Bestandteil der Ausschreibung ist die Lieferung und Montage von - 1 Leichenkühlzellenanlage mit Einzelfächern für 21 Verstorbenen (davon 3 Plätze adipöse) - 1 Leichenkühlzellenanlage für 1 radioaktive Verstorbenen - 18 Leichenmulde Standardgröße - 3 Leichenmulde Adipositas-Größe - 1 Leichenmulde Standardgröße für radioaktive Verstorbene - 1 Wasch- und Seziertisch fahrbar mit Schnittstelle Andockstation - 1 Andocksäule für fahrbaren Seziertisch - 1 Seziertisch, fahrbar für die Entnahme der Hornhäute - 1 Scherenwagen für Sargtransport - 3 Hydraulischer Leichenmulden-Hubwagen für Standardgröße und adipöse Verstorbene - 1 Katafalkrahmen, fahrbar, mit Kühlung inkl. Behang und Mulde - 1 Gefriertruhe für Körperteile mit Temperaturüberwachung - 2 Standleuchter (Elektrokerzen) Die Lieferung und Montage der Bestandteile soll nach dem folgenden Prioritäten-Schema getrennt ablaufen: Montage Unterkonstruktionen, Montage Leichenkühlzellanlagen, Lieferung Zubehör unmittelbar vor Inbetriebnahme (Diebstahlprävention). 1 Haupt- und 1 Nachbesserungstermin sind mit dem Angebotspreis abgegolten, wobei die Teilleistungen gemäß Terminplan gestaffelt einzutakten und mit der örtlichen Bauleitung/Fachbauleitung abzustimmen sind. Die gesetzliche Verjährungsfrist der Gewährleistungsansprüche beginnt mit der Abnahme der Leistung. Der Tag der Abnahme (komplette Montage inklusive Mängelbeseitigungen) ist der Gewährleistungsbeginn. Folgende Leistungen sind neben den gerätebezogenen Leistungen anzubieten und zu kalkulieren: - Bei der Kollisionsprüfung durch den koordinierenden Architekten (4Bund) ist durch den Auftragnehmer (AN) mitzuwirken. Die Montagepläne sind bei Erfordernis anzupassen. - Für Organisationsbesprechungen - auch teil- und abschnittsweise - hat der AN einen mit der Anlage in allen Teilen technisch und betrieblich vertrauten, sachkundigen Mitarbeiter beizustellen. - Weitere Leitungen gemäß den zusätzlichen technischen Vorbemerkungen der Medizintechnik. Eignungskriterien gemäß allgemeinen und besonderen Vertragsbedingungen, Punkt 1.10 / Punkt 2.10 Für die Lieferungen und Montagen der Geräte sind folgende Termine maßgebend: Möglicher Beginn Einbau: 24.09.2027 Spätester Abschluss Montagen: 29.03.2029 (Innenausbau + Technik gem. Generalablaufplan_V5) Unter Berücksichtigung des Starttermins ist ein Montageterminplan vorzulegen und ggf. an Vorgaben des Architekten (4Bund) anzupassen. Die jeweils für die Einbringung und Montage benötigten Zeiten sind pro Gerät zu hinterlegen.

title: Construction Services for Confined Aquatic Disposal Cell Construction and Maintenance Dredging of the Providence River Federal Navigation Project, Providence, Rhode Island.
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New England District is issuing a Sources Sought Announcement for the upcoming dredging project located in Providence, Rhode Island. This announcement is to determine the interest, availability and capability of Small and Large Business concerns as described below. The NAICS code for this procurement is 237990. The solicitation for this project is anticipated to be issued on or about 15 March 2027. The construction will begin in September 2027 and is expected to take approximately 2 years to complete. The estimated construction cost is between $80,000,000 and $100,000,000. The Providence River Maintenance Dredging project involves two major sequences of dredging and disposal activities. The first work sequence will be the construction of a new Confined Aquatic Disposal (CAD) cell adjacent to the Providence River. The second work sequence under this contract will include maintenance dredging of the Providence River and Harbor Federal Navigation Project (FNP) to its authorized depths and dimensions. The proposed work consists of mechanically dredging approximately 5,500,000 cubic yards (cy) of material using closed clamshell buckets for both major sequences of work over the course of two years. The new CAD cell will be in the Edgewood Basin area located adjacent to the Providence FNP (hereafter the �Edgewood Shoals North (ESN) CAD cell�). To access the CAD cell area, an access channel will be dug between the Providence FNP and the CAD cell area. The access channel will be approximately 100 ft wide and -25 MLLW deep. The CAD cell will have surface dimensions of approximately 1000 ft. by 1000 ft. and be dug to a depth of -60 MLLW. The material excavated to build the access channel is generally a mix of sandy silt and shell fragments. Within the CAD cell area the material is generally described as soft grey to black organic silt with some layers of firm sandy silt and some shell fragments and coarse-grained material. Material excavated from the access channel and CAD cell area will be placed at four locations: Port Edgewood Basin, the Fox Point Reach CAD cells, Prudence Island Disposal Site, and the Rhode Island Sound Disposal Site. This work consists of mechanically dredging approximately 3,200,000 cy to construct thew ESN CAD cell and its access channel, which must be completed before maintenance dredging of the FNP can begin. The maintenance dredging proposed work consists of mechanically dredging the Providence River FNP to the full -40 MLLW depth plus 2-feet of allowable overdepth. 2,300,000 cy (1,200,000 cy required depth, with up to 1,100,000 cy overdepth) of shoaled material consisting generally of poorly graded medium to fine sand with silt. The dredge material from this maintenance portion of work will be placed in the ESN CAD cell. Environmental coordination and permitting is being completed by the U.S. Army of Engineers, New England District. All dredging and disposal activities for this project have prescribed work windows that incorporate environmental and recreational time of year restrictions. Refer to the Draft Specification Section provided with this announcement for specifics on the time of year work restrictions. In order to accomplish all dredging requirements within the specified dredging window it is expected that the Contractor will need to meet a production rate of 300,000 CY per 30 calendar days. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New England District is requesting responses to the questions below from both small and large businesses[MC1] . Draft drawings showing a concept design plan and draft Specification Section of 01 11 00 SUMMARY OF WORK have been provided with this announcement to help provide more context for the contract work and responses to these questions. Considering the different disposal locations, are there suggestions on a bid structure that will provide for the most accurate costs of different disposal locations? Any draft restrictions that may impact dredging and/or disposal operations? Any concerns on the period of performance of September 2027 to September 2029 considering the environmental windows and amount of work? If so, why? Any comments about the bed leveling planned in the Fox Point Reach? Are there concerns about this part of the plan, if so, why? Interested firms should also demonstrate their project experience, by providing two (2) projects within the last ten years, which meet the following requirements: Dredging by mechanical means demonstrating a minimum production rate of 300,000 cubic yards in one consecutive 30-day period. Experience with placement of dredged material at an open water placement site in New England during the fall/winter months of October through March. Interested firms should submit a capabilities package to include the following: business classification (i.e. HUBZone, etc.), type of equipment the firm is proposing to use on the project, and two (2) example projects performed by the firm in the last ten (10) years (including Points of Contact for those projects) showing experience with the proposed equipment at the production rate listed above. Please indicate the team subcontractor(s) (if any), including their prior experience and qualifications meeting the same qualifications listed above, which will be used to support the bidder's effort. Firms may use subcontractor experience to demonstrate experience with the requirements, but the role and work performed by each team member (prime and subcontractors) on projects demonstrating that team member's experience shall be the same as the role for that team member for this project. Bid bond will need to be provided with the bid. Responses are limited to twenty pages and due by December 03 , 2026. Responses should be addressed to the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, New England District, 696 Virginia Road, Concord, MA 01742-2751, ATTN: Kyle Hall, or electronically to Kyle.K.Hall@usace.army.mil. The Government will not pay for any material provided in response to this market survey nor return the data provided. This notice is for information purposes only and is not a request to be placed on a solicitation mailing list nor is it a Request for Proposal (RFP) or an announcement of a solicitation. The results of this survey will be considered to be in effect for a period of one year from the date of this notice. title: CI31 - Excavation et construction de la structure auxiliaire SA6
PIGA Float Assembly Repair Program
description: Login at https://piee.eb.mil and search for 'FA821426RB002' to obtain more details.* Documents related to this procurment are only available through PIEE. 1. Executive Summary: Background & Objective The U.S. Air Force has a critical requirement to support the Minuteman III (MMIII) Intercontinental Ballistic Missile (ICBM) by maintaining the operational readiness of the Missile Guidance Set (MGS) to meet warfighter requirements. Specifically, this effort supports the repair line for the Pendulous Integrated Gyroscopic Accelerometer (PIGA) Float Assembly. The PIGA Float is a critical and precise sub-assembly that serves as the heart of the PIGA instrument, enabling it to measure missile acceleration. Each MGS contains three separate PIGA instruments (each housing a PIGA Float). Without this critical component, the ICBM would cease to function properly. The PIGA Float repair effort is a continuous operation necessary to avoid mission degradation. Quality control and precision engineering are paramount due to the strategic importance of the MMIII weapon system. The contractor must maintain stringent quality assurance protocols to guarantee that each repaired PIGA Float meets the rigorous military specifications. 2. Scope of Work The contractor shall provide the necessary personnel, facilities, and expertise to support the PIGA Float Assembly repair line. The primary scope includes: Repair Operations - The re-manufacture, rebuild, and repair of PIGA Float Assemblies. Volume / Throughput - The repair of 96 PIGA Floats per year. Government Furnished Equipment (GFE) - The repair and/or replacement of GFE as required to support continuous operation of the PIGA Float repair line 3. Contract Structure & Period of Performance The Government anticipates awarding an Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract utilizing a mix of Cost-Plus-Fixed-Fee (CPFF) and Firm-Fixed-Price (FFP) pricing arrangements. Contract Duration - 5-Year IDIQ Anticipated Ordering Period - 1 November 2026 � 31 October 2031 Task Order Structure - Annual issuance of new, two-year non-severable Task Orders 4. Acquisition Authority & Strategy In accordance with Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 5.1, this solicitation is an intended sole-source procurement. The Government will solicit and negotiate with only one source: Honeywell Aerospace (CAGE: 09128). This action is taken under the authority of 10 U.S.C. 3204(a)(1), as implemented by RFO 6.103-1. Market research�including Sources Sought Synopsis FA821425CBPIGA (posted 29 May 2025)�concluded that Honeywell Aerospace is the only responsible source capable of fulfilling the Government�s requirement without causing unacceptable delays to the MMIII weapon system mission. Note: While this is not a request for competitive proposals, information received from other responsible sources identifying their interest and capability will be considered solely to determine whether to conduct a competitive procurement in the future, at the Government�s discretion. 5. title: LOWER BRULE NORTH SHORELINE STABILIZATION AND ECOSYSTEM RESTORATION, ELEMENT 2
description: The project is located along the left descending bank of Lake Sharpe near the Lower Brule, SD town site. Lower Brule North Element 2 includes a 100-foot-wide riparian planting bench, a gravel maintenance path along the entire reach, a riprap revetment to protect the shoreline and island from erosion, and the creation of a 200-by-1,500-foot island constructed in water up to three feet deep. The sheltered open water area between the island and the shoreline will develop into approximately 5.17 acres of emergent wetland, and this will also create approximately 32 acres of riparian habitat. Related tasks include earth moving, grading, bank shaping, rock installation, water management, fill, and topsoil placement.

title: Weapons Shipping Harness Refurbishment Blanket Purchase Agreement
description: This is a limited sources combined synopsis/solicitation for services prepared in accordance with simplified acquisition procedures found in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Revolutionary Far Overhaul (RFO) Subpart 13.2, effective 1 February 2026, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation/notice; further written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation Number N6278927Q0001 is issued as a Request for Quotes (RFQ). The solicitation and incorporated provisions and clauses are in effect through the most current Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01 with an effective date of 13 March 2026. The Product and Service Code (PSC) is J019. The North American Industry Classification (NAICS) code is 336419. Supervisor of Shipbuilding Conversion and Repair, Groton CT (SSGR) intends to enter into a multiple award Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA), for a period of 5 years. The vendor shall refurbish weapon Shipping Harnesses in accordance with the attached specification. The Period of Performance shall be 27 January 2027 to 26 January 2032. Each BPA will have up to a five (5) year ordering period with a ceiling of up to $500,000. The BPA Call Limit will be $100,000. The ceiling of each agreement can be increased or decreased at any time by the Contracting Officer via bilateral modification to meet current and future requirements. Funding is not assigned to the BPA. The Government will only be obligated to the extent of calls placed against an awarded BPA. Each BPA call will be competed among the agreement holders as requirements arise. A call will then be placed based on the quote that is most advantageous to the Government. Offerors must provide a description of their property management system per FAR 45.201(c)(4) or confirmation of a property management system that has been reviewed and approved per DFARS 242.302 and meets the requirements of FAR 52.245-1(f). Offerors shall submit a pricing schedule that covers each year of the Period of Performance as follows: Fiscal Year Service Unit Unit Price Amount 2027 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX 2028 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX 2029 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX 2030 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX 2031 U-SSN 688 Weapon Shipping Harness Refurb 1 JOB $XX.XX $XX.XX Quotations are due prior to 4:00PM EST, 3 December 2026. Late submissions will not be accepted. Offers should be submitted via electronic commerce. The electronic address for receipt of offers is: kyle.r.berg3.civ@us.navy.mil and stephanie.l.neale.civ@us.navy.mil. Offerors should identify the RFQ number in the Subject Line of the email. Offerors are advised to submit electronic documents early and confirm successful transmission/receipt. The System for Award Management (SAM) is a Government maintained database of companies wanting to do business with the Government. A firm must register and maintain an active SAM registration in order to receive a federal award. Register at: https://sam.gov/SAM/pages/public/index.js EVALUATION FACTORS FOR AWARD: The Government intends to enter into a multiple award Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA), for a period of 5 years. Each BPA call will be competed among the agreement holders as requirements arise. The Government will make award(s) to the offeror(s) that represent the best value to the Government based on the following factors, in order: -Technical Qualifications/Ability to meet schedule -Past Performance -Price The Government intends to evaluate proposals and award a contract without discussions with offerors. However, the Government reserves the right to conduct discussions if later determined by the Contracting Officer to be necessary. The Government reserves the right to award one line, all line items, or any combination thereof. If multiple line items are awarded, cost/prices for each line item will be totaled and the award amount will be based on that total. See Section M of the solicitation for additional details.

title: Hankintailmoitus: LapIT Oy:n vakuutusturvan hankinnan kilpailutus
description: Hankintailmoitus: LapIT Oy:n vakuutusturvan hankinnan kilpailutus LapIT Oy (myöhemmin Tilaaja) pyytää tarjouksia vakuutusturvasta ja siihen liittyvistä palveluista tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. LapIT Oy:n vakuutusturva ja sen laajuus on kuvattu tarjouspyynnön liitteissä. Ensimmäinen vakuutuskausi on 1.1.2027-31.12.2027. Tämän jälkeen vakuutuskausi on kalenterivuosi. Tarjous jätetään alkaen täydestä kalenterivuodesta (2027). LapIT Oy:llä on oikeus vakuutuskausien aikana kilpailuttaa vakuutukset uudelleen ja siirtää vakuutukset kilpailutuksen voittajalle. Vakuutukset ovat voimassa toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Hankinnan sopimuskausi on kolme (3) vuotta, jonka jälkeen LapIT Oy:llä on oikeus jatkaa sopimuskautta yhdellä (1) kahden (2) vuoden optiokaudella. Optiokauden jälkeen LapIT Oy:llä on oikeus jatkaa hankintaa toistaiseksi voimassa olevana optiokautena. Lisähankintamahdollisuus: LapIT Oy varaa oikeuden laajentaa sopimusta, mikäli se perustuu hankintamenettelyn aikana tiedossa olleisiin ja hankinta-asiakirjoissa mainittuihin sopimusehtoihin tai niiden muuttamista koskeviin ehtoihin, niiden rahallisesta arvosta riippumatta, ja nämä ehdot ovat selkeät, täsmälliset ja yksiselitteiset, eivätkä ne muuta hankintasopimuksen yleistä luonnetta (1397/2016, 14 luku, 136 §, 2 mom., 1 kohta); tai mikäli alkuperäisen sopimuskumppanin on tarpeen suorittaa lisätöitä tai -palveluja taikka ylimääräisiä tavarantoimituksia, jotka eivät sisältyneet alkuperäiseen sopimukseen, ja jos sopimuskumppanin vaihtaminen ei ole mahdollista taloudellisista tai teknisistä syistä ja aiheuttaisi merkittävää haittaa tai kustannusten merkittävää päällekkäisyyttä hankintayksikölle (1397/2016, 14 luku, 136 §, 2 mom., 2 kohta). LapIT Oy on pohjoissuomalainen ICT -infra ja perustietotekniikan palveluita omistajilleen tuottava in-house -yhtiö. Omistajiimme kuuluu pohjoisen Suomen kuntia, hyvinvointialueita, kunta- ja hyvinvointialueyhtymiä sekä kuntaomisteisia osakeyhtiötä. LapIT Oy on velvollinen kilpailuttamaan tarvitsemansa palvelut markkinoilta hankintalain mukaisesti. Hankinnan kilpailutus on hankintalain (Laki julkisista hankinnoista ja käyttöoikeussopimuksista 1397/2016) mukainen EU-kynnysarvon ylittävä palveluhankinta. Hankinnan kilpailutuksen sisältö vakuutusturvan osalta on seuraavanlainen: Työtapaturma- ja ammattitautivakuutus: - Lakisääteinen ryhmätapaturmavakuutus työntekijöille (TyTAL) Henkilövakuutukset: - Sairauskuluvakuutukset (sairauskuluvakuutus, ryhmävakuutus) Muut tarkemmat tiedot on ilmoitettu muualla hankintailmoituksessa, tarjouspyynnössä sekä hankinta-asiakirjoissa ja liitteissä.,

title: Tactical Communication Systems - Procurement, Services & Sustainment (TCS-PSS) Call for Solutions
description: Project Title: Tactical Communication Systems Procurement, Services & Sustainment (TCS-PSS) Reference Number: CSO-ARMY-TCS-PSS-2027 Primary NAICS: 334220 � Radio and Television Broadcasting and Wireless Communications Equipment Manufacturing 1. Opportunity Overview The Department of the Army, representing the Capability Program Executive Command and Control Information Network (CPE C2IN), the Project Manager Command and Control Transport (PM C2T), and the Product Manager Tactical Communication Systems (PdM TCS), has issued a Call for Solutions (CfS) under Defense Federal Acquisition Regulation Supplement (DFARS) Part 212.70 to establish a 10-year enterprise acquisition framework for innovative tactical communication capabilities. This initiative seeks to secure a mix of single-award Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts and/or Other Transactions (OTs) to streamline the procurement, testing, fielding, and lifecycle sustainment of both legacy systems and emerging transport hardware and software. Focused on supporting Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2), the effort aims to deliver highly secure�National Security Agency (NSA) High Assurance certified or Sensitive but Unclassified - Encrypted (SBU-E) qualified�resilient, and interoperable communication systems. To counter future cryptographic threats, the framework is seeking capable vendors to provide a plan for incorporating Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) compliant algorithms and achieving National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) validation by 31 December 2030, ensuring robust data protection and mission command resilience in contested joint and coalition environments. 2. Critical Milestones & How to Respond Questions & Comments Due: 04 November 2026 at 16:00 EST White Papers Due: 03 December 2026 at 17:00 EST 3. Points of Contact Contracting Officer: Jennifer Anderson, jennifer.d.anderson57.civ@army.mil Contract Specialist: Aaliyah Coles, aaliyah.m.coles.civ@army.mil Please refer to the attached Call for Solutions (CSO-ARMY-TCS-PSS-2027) document for full submission instructions, evaluation criteria, and detailed technical characteristics. Amendment 2 (26 October 2026) � The submission schedule for the TCS-PSS Call for Solutions has been revised. The deadline for submitting questions is now extended to 04 November 2026, and the submission deadline for White Papers has been extended to 03 December 2026. To reiterate, to request access to Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) documents, vendors must complete the following steps: SAM.gov Request: Submit an access request directly through the SAM.gov posting. (Note: ONLY SUBMIT ONE DOCUMENT APPROVAL REQUEST THROUGH SAM.GOV PER VENDOR). Email Verification Package: Send an email to jennifer.d.anderson57.civ@army.mil,; aaliyah.m.coles.civ@army.mil; and douglas.g.thier.civ@army.mil containing: Approved DD Form 2345 CAGE Code Joint Certification Program (JCP) Number Signed Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) for all individuals requiring access to CUI document 3. Reminder, all vendor questions regarding this CfS must be submitted via the designated Microsoft Forms link. Important: No vendor emails containing questions regarding the CfS will be answered or responded to. The Government will consolidate and provide formal answers to all submitted questions following the final receipt of questions. All other terms, conditions, and submission guidelines remain unchanged. Amendment 1 (19 October 2026; 1600 EST) - The purpose of this amendment is to establish the mandatory security and verification protocols for vendors requesting access to the CUI and Export-Controlled attachments associated with this Call for Solutions. Certain attachments referenced in this Call for Solutions are marked as Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) with Limited Dissemination Controls and/or Export Controls. The dissemination of Export-Controlled information is restricted by the Arms Export Control Act or the Export Administration Act of 1979. Export-controlled items shall not be disseminated outside the U.S. Government or to U.S. Government contractors without first verifying the recipient�s eligibility and authority to receive export-controlled information by verifying they have a current, valid DD Form 2345. Interested vendors must provide their CAGE Code, a copy of the DD2345, and their Joint Certification Program (JCP) number to Contracting Officer Jennifer Anderson (jennifer.d.anderson57.civ@army.mil), Contract Specialist Aaliyah Coles (aaliyah.m.coles.civ@army.mil) and Contract Specialist Douglas Thier (douglas.g.thier.civ@army.mil). Once the CAGE Code and JCP data has been verified the Controlled documents will be sent to interested parties. Additionally, vendors will be required to submit a Non-disclosure Agreement (NDA), for all personnel requiring access to these documents. A copy of this NDA can be obtained by emailing the Contracting Officer Jennifer Anderson (jennifer.d.anderson57.civ@army.mil), Contract Specialist Aaliyah Coles (aaliyah.m.coles.civ@army.mil) and Contract Specialist Douglas Thier (douglas.g.thier.civ@army.mil). title: Rammeaftale om flytteydelser
description: Udbudsprocessen omfatter en aftale med Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen (ETK) om levering af flytteydelser. ETK udbyder flytteydelser på Forsvarets etablissementer, forstået som flytning imellem etablissementer, på etablissementer, nedtagning samt opbevaring. Flytteydelser kan ligeledes indebære, nedtagning, udpakning og opsætning af kontorpladser fordelt på fem (5) regionale delaftaler. Det nærmere indhold og omfang af ydelserne fremgår af Rammeaftalen. Flytteydelser vil skulle udføres på Forsvarets lokationer som fremgår af Aftalebilag 2 - Etablissement oversigt. Antallet af etablissementer vil kunne ændre sig i aftaleperioden. Udbuddet er opdelt geografisk i følgende fem (5) delaftaler: Delaftale 1: Region Nordjylland Delaftale 2: Region Midtjylland Delaftale 3: Region Syddanmark Delaftale 4: Region Sjælland Delaftale 5: Region Hovedstaden Delaftalerne er opdelt geografisk, for at gøre det muligt for mindre og mellemstore lokale virksomheder at byde på opgaven. Der kan afgives tilbud på en eller flere af de udbudte delaftaler. Tilbudsgiver skal i ESPD del ll.A. angive, hvilke delaftaler I ønsker at afgive tilbud på. Der skal afleveres et (1) tilbud per delaftale, som Tilbudsgiver ønsker at afgive tilbud på. Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen gør opmærksom på, at det er muligt for en Tilbudsgiver at få tildelt alle delaftaler. Rammeaftalen tildeles to Leverandører, som rangeres på en kaskade på baggrund af ETK's tilbudsevaluering, jf. udbudsbetingelsernes pkt. 4. Konkrete ordrer på Rammeaftalen bliver tildelt som følger: Ordrer tildeles den første Leverandør i kaskaden. Såfremt denne Leverandør ikke kan udføre ordren indenfor den fastsatte frist jf. pkt. 9.1, vil den anden Leverandør i kaskaden blive tildelt ordren. Det estimeres, at Rammeaftalen har en økonomisk værdi på 24 mio. i den samlede kon-traktperiode. Værdien er alene udtryk for ETK’s bedste skøn på udbudstidspunktet, der baserer sig på tidligere indkøb samt kommende forventede indkøb. Skønnet er ikke bindende for ETK eller udtryk for en garanteret minimumsomsætning for Leverandøren. ETK har således ikke pligt til at aftage en bestemt mængde. Rammeaftalens maksimale økonomiske værdi i den samlede kontraktperiode udgør i alt 48 mio. DKK. Det maksimale økonomiske omfang udgør en ret til for ETK at købe via Rammeaftalen uanset indkøbsvolumen måtte overstige den estimerede værdi. Den maksimale økonomiske værdi er et udtryk for en samlet økonomisk værdi for alle delaftalerne og benyttes derfor på tværs af delaftalerne. Rammeaftalen ophører uden varsel, såfremt den maksimale værdi overskrides forud for kontraktperiodens ophør. Årsagen til Rammeaftalens maksimale værdi er risikoen for, at ETK’s fremtidige behov over-stiger det på udbudstidspunktet estimerede behov særligt henset til den øgede økonomi og aktivitetsniveau i Forsvaret som følge af Forsvarsforliget for 2024-2033, Aftale om styrkelse af Forsvarets kampkraft af 22. februar 2025 og den nuværende sikkerhedspolitiske situation.

title: R408--Center Mall Survey
TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: Clathrate Therapeutics Platform
description: This technology from scientists at Los Alamos National Laboratory represents a novel platform for improving the safety and effectiveness of therapeutic gas-based treatments by enabling controlled, localized delivery at the site of disease. By addressing longstanding challenges associated with systemic exposure and dosing precision, the platform enhances the clinical viability of gas therapies across high-value markets such as oncology, cardiovascular care, and regenerative medicine. In addition, the inclusion of a complementary predictive modeling capability supports treatment optimization and development efficiency, reducing technical risk and accelerating translation. Together, these capabilities position the technology as a differentiated and scalable solution that can unlock new commercial opportunities in areas where gas-based therapeutics have shown promise but faced delivery limitations. The Opportunity: Therapeutic gases have demonstrated meaningful biological effects across oncology, cardiovascular disease, neuroprotection and regenerative medicine, yet their clinical adoption has been limited by a fundamental challenge: safe, controlled and localized delivery. Existing approaches often result in rapid release, systemic exposure or narrow therapeutic windows, creating safety, regulatory and development barriers. The Clathrate Therapeutics Platform addresses this unmet need by positioning gas-based therapies as programmable, targetable and commercially viable treatment modalities. By enabling more precise control over where and how therapeutic gases are delivered, the platform has the potential to unlock new product categories, enhance combination treatment strategies and accelerate translation of gas-based therapeutics into high-value clinical markets. How it Works: The Clathrate Therapeutics Platform uses a proprietary, controlled-release system designed to localize therapeutic gases at the intended treatment site rather than allowing them to disperse systemically. This technology temporarily stabilizes the gas within a biocompatible structure that gradually releases it under physiological conditions, enabling sustained and targeted exposure. This controlled release approach is designed to support therapeutic concentrations where needed while limiting circulating levels elsewhere in the body. An integrated computational modeling capability further supports optimization of dosing profiles and treatment parameters, helping guide development decisions prior to in vivo studies. Key Advantages: Localized delivery: Targets therapeutic gases to the intended site while minimizing systemic exposure. Controlled release: Designed for sustained, tunable dosing under physiological conditions. Improved safety margin: Aims to separate therapeutic effect from toxicity risk. Platform versatility: Applicable across oncology, cardiovascular, neurological and regenerative indications. Development optimization: Supported by predictive modeling to guide dose and design decisions. Partnership-ready architecture: Suitable for integration with drug-device combinations and existing treatment modalities. title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: Heat Pipe Reactor Wick and Fill Platform
description: This technology platform from Los Alamos National Laboratory enables more reliable high-temperature heat pipe reactors by improving the way critical wick structures are manufactured and how heat pipe arrays are filled, sealed, and checked for quality. A stronger wick gives the system the capillary action needed to move liquid metal through the pipe under demanding thermal conditions, while the fill platform helps prepare clean, repeatable assemblies that are better suited for reactor-grade use. For organizations working in nuclear, space, or other high-heat environments, the Heat Pipe Reactor Wick and Fill Platform offers a more practical route to building durable thermal hardware with fewer manufacturing bottlenecks. How it Works The Heat Pipe Reactor Wick and Fill Platform begins with wick fabrication, where a fine mesh or similar material is shaped around a mandrel and compressed so the layers can be bonded into a strong porous tube. Depending on the version, the wick can be formed by drawing, hydroforming, or other controlled shaping methods before diffusion bonding locks the structure in place. After bonding, the temporary mandrel and sheath are removed by etching, leaving a porous wick with the pore structure and geometry needed for high-temperature alkali metal heat pipes. The fill process is designed to load, seal, and inspect heat pipe arrays under controlled atmosphere conditions, often using vacuum or inert gas environments. That workflow can be automated with precision metering, controlled handling, and laser welding, which helps improve repeatability and reduce contamination risk. Quality control can be built into both the wick and fill steps through inspection of the porous structure, leak testing, fill verification, and process monitoring, all of which support more consistent reactor-scale production. Technical Description The wick fabrication methods focus on producing a porous annular structure with the strength and capillary performance required for high-temperature heat pipe reactors. In one approach, mesh layers are wrapped around an etchable mandrel, compressed inside a sheath, and diffusion bonded so the layers fuse into a stable structure. After bonding, the mandrel and sheath are removed chemically, leaving a porous tube that functions as the wick. Related versions use hydroforming or modular splicing to support curved, variable or larger-format wick geometries that are difficult to make with conventional methods. A second technical element is the fill, seal and inspection platform for heat pipe arrays. The Heat Pipe Reactor Wick and Fill Platform is intended to meter alkali-metal working fluid into multiple heat pipes under vacuum or inert conditions, then seal the assemblies with controlled welding or bonding steps. Built-in inspection can confirm seal integrity, working-fluid fill quality and process repeatability. The combination of automated handling and quality control makes the technology more suitable for scale-up, especially where contamination control and consistent output are essential. Advantages Supports high-temperature heat transport in demanding environments Improves manufacturability of complex wick structures Helps increase reliability and consistency in heat pipe production Enables more scalable filling, sealing and inspection of heat pipe arrays Better suited for long-life, high-purity alkali-metal systems Strong fit for compact, passive thermal management applications Market Applications Nuclear Energy (microreactors, reactor heat transport, thermal management systems) Space (space reactors, power conversion, radiator-side heat rejection) Aerospace (high-reliability thermal control, compact heat transport) Defense (remote power systems, mission-critical thermal hardware) Advanced Manufacturing (specialized heat pipe production tools and processes) Industrial Energy Systems (high-temperature heat recovery and thermal transport) In addition to patent licensing, Los Alamos may loan a full-scale prototype, modular alkali metal heat-pipe fill system hardware allowing the fill and seal of individual or large arrays of alkali metal heat pipes. title: Spain – Buildings of particular historical or architectural interest – Obras de rehabilitación del Almacén de Abastos de Ceuta como Archivo General y Museo Militar
description: El Almacén de Abastos forma parte del conjunto histórico de fortificaciones de la Almina, declarado BIC en la categoría de Monumento. Constituye uno de los restos que quedan de la fortificación de la Almina y su función fue servir de almacenaje y logística al conjunto del enclave. El Almacén de Abastos se dispone en el extremo oriental del sector septentrional del Conjunto de la Almina. La línea amurallada de este frente discurriría justo al norte de esta construcción, situándose a su altura la batería de Abastos. El fin del proyecto consiste en la rehabilitación y adecuación del histórico Almacén de Abastos de Ceuta para incorporar dos nuevos equipamientos culturales: el Museo Militar en la planta baja y el Archivo General de la Ciudad en la planta primera. La intervención busca conservar y poner en valor la arquitectura existente, garantizando al mismo tiempo las necesidades funcionales y ambientales de ambos usos. En la planta baja, el Museo Militar se organiza en áreas públicas y de trabajo. Se incluyen también zonas de acogida, descanso y servicios, y espacios internos para almacenamiento de piezas y gestión administrativa. En la planta primera, el Archivo General se divide en área pública, depósitos y zona de trabajo. Los depósitos deberán albergar un volumen documental muy amplio con recorridos visitables. El área de trabajo incorpora espacios de recepción y limpieza de documentos, catalogación, conservación y reprografía, junto con puestos de atención al ciudadano y despachos. El proyecto proporciona así una nueva vida cultural al edificio, combinando funcionalidad contemporánea, preservación patrimonial y servicio público. El ámbito total de intervención comprende 3.079 m2 construidos.

la part Concessionnaire, - la part de l'autorité concédante, - les droits et redevances additionnels du prix de l'eau destinés à des organismes publics, - les taxes, redevances ou contributions que le Concessionnaire serait amené à percevoir auprès des abonnés par suite de décisions qui lui seraient imposées. Ce contrat prévoit également l'obligation pour le concessionnaire de mise en place d'une comptabilité analytique séparée pour les activités production d'une part et distribution d'autre part

buyer: Presidencia del Consejo de Administración de la Autoridad Portuaria de Barcelona (PORT DE BARCELONA)
title: Spain – Roadworks – Nuevos accesos a la ampliación sur del puerto de Barcelona. Fase 2A. Clave de expediente: OB-GP-P-0870/2020
description: El objeto de la presente licitación es la contratación de la obra Nuevos accesos a la ampliación sur del Puerto de Barcelona. Fase 2A que consiste en la construcción de un nuevo nudo viario que permita la adecuada articulación entre la red viaria estructurante del puerto de Barcelona y la nueva autovía de acceso al puerto. Este nudo viario, a desarrollar sobre la antigua desembocadura del rio Llobregat, constituirá la infraestructura viaria más importante del puerto y deberá ser compatible con el importante nudo ferroviario a desarrollar en el antiguo cauce. Este enlace viario consistirá en una gran rotonda elevada con tres ramales, cuyos condicionantes vienen impuestos por la infraestructura ferroviaria a desarrollar en ese mismo emplazamiento. Este enlace consta de una conexión con la nueva autovía, otra conexión con la ampliación Sur y una tercera conexión que permitirá el acceso a las instalaciones portuarias situadas al norte de la antigua desembocadura. El enlace dispondrá también de 3 carriles directos. También tiene como objeto facilitar el futuro cruce bajo la infraestructura ferroviaria de redes de servicios para lo cual se ha proyectado una galería de servicios. Asimismo, incluye una conexión de carácter provisional con la infraestructura viaria situada al norte. La conexión provisional, incluida en esta actuación, permite la conexión con la calle 4. Quedará pendiente para desarrollar en el futuro una conexión definitiva, que no es objeto de este contrato. Esa conexión definitiva incluirá un viaducto que permitirá la conexión directa del nuevo enlace con la calle 3 del puerto. La ejecución de esa conexión definitiva con la zona norte (Proyecto de Nuevos Access a la Ampliación Sur. Fase 2B) será ejecutada posteriormente a la construcción del nuevo atraque 35B cuya ejecución condiciona los espacios necesarios para el desarrollo del futuro viaducto. La obra deberá ejecutarse de conformidad con el Proyecto publicado, que incluye en su contenido el Pliego de Prescripciones Técnicas.
